title: Aligned Malloc

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of bytes to allocate (must be > 0)

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.description: Required alignment in bytes (power of 2, >= sizeof(void*))

parameters.name: ptr
parameters.description: Pointer previously returned by aligned_malloc, or NULL

constraints: alignment must be a power of 2 and >= sizeof(void*)
Return NULL if parameters are invalid or malloc fails
aligned_free(NULL) must be a safe no-op
Allocated memory must be writable for 'size' bytes from the returned pointer
